title: Paul McCartney live: Festhalle, Frankfurt | 1993
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the Festhalle in Frankfurt, Germany, on 23 February 1993.

It was the fourth night of the New World Tour, which lasted for 77 dates across 19 countries between February and December 1993, and the second of two consecutive nights in Frankfurt.

McCartney’s band was Linda McCartney on vocals, keyboards, and percussion; Hamish Stuart on guitar, bass guitar, and vocals; Robbie McIntosh on guitar and vocals; Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens on keyboards and vocals; and Blair Cunningham on drums and percussion.

The New World Tour returned to the Festhalle on 6 October 1993. McCartney had previously performed there on 6 and 7 October 1989.
